scenario.name: engine-probe
scenario.description: Engine probe: generate/build/boot/serve the same app on every engine. The database block is deliberately absent -- run-engine-app-proof.py writes db.definition.json per engine from the CLI's own registry, because that is the file a real user's `npdev init --engine` produces.

notes: Engine probe for E3/E4/E5. The engine is chosen by run-engine-app-proof.py, not by this file.
Do not add features: a probe that grows stops being comparable across engines.
